description: Supabase deploy adapter: the deploy-time SQL migration round, plus the isolated e2e stack. Active iff the consuming project's harness.config.json has a `deploy` block with adapter=supabase.

generate.note: developer-dispatched skill that generates SQL under supabase/migrations/ from the session-branch schema diff

review.note: single-shot migration-review mode gates the generated SQL before merge

writeGuard.note: blocks migration SQL writes outside the deploy-time round

e2eSmoke.note: isolated slot-leased Supabase + Playwright, launched by hooks/e2e-on-feature-review.mjs, never by an agent

promptFragments.note: The Supabase-specific sections still live inline in agents/quality-reviewer.md (A.6b schema changes, B.1 RLS), agents/planner.md, agents/developer.md and agents/orchestrator.md. Extracting them so this adapter owns them is the next step; until then a non-Supabase project has to edit those prompts. See HARNESS-SPLIT.md.

note: Paths are relative to the plugin root (CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT), or to the project's .claude/ when the harness was copied in rather than installed. hooks/lib/paths.mjs harnessFile() resolves both.
